title: Buena Vista Social Club (bc30)
synopsis: This documentary by lauded German filmmaker Wim Wenders follows Ry Cooder, a renowned guitarist and Wenders’ frequent musical collaborator, and his son, Joachim, as they travel to Cuba and assemble a group of the country's finest musicians to record an album. Among the artists included in the project are singer Ibrahim Ferrer and pianist Rubén González, who are both interviewed and featured in studio footage. Eventually the ensemble travels to the United States to perform in front of rapt audiences.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 雲溫達斯的音樂城市筆記，藉著訪問年邁樂手，到追擊他們由夏灣拿征服紐約的精彩演出，將古巴音樂熱潮推至最高！手持迷你數碼攝錄機深入夏灣拿，在熱情的粉色建築與拉丁音樂聲中遊走，捕捉拉丁音樂的風情與故事。
